observations: Single photo shows a white console lying flat on a dark sofa, with a white DualSense-style controller resting on top of it.
No cables, power brick, box, or packaging visible.
No serial number, model number, or regulatory label visible on the console body.
No screen-on or power-on evidence; console appears off/unplugged.
Faint reflective streaks across the console surface could be light glare or surface scratches; cannot distinguish from this angle.
Watermark text 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' overlaid on image, seller's own branding, not a certification mark.

identity.kind: PS5 console with one wireless gamepad

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a top-down angle with controller obscuring most of the body shape; cannot confirm slim vs standard chassis from this view.
No region sticker, box, or plug/cable shown in photo 0 to confirm UK origin.
Photo 0 shows one DualSense-style controller resting on the console.
No power-on, screen, or boot footage provided.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (disc drive, HDMI port, overheating).
risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on to home screen, plus disc drive ejecting/loading if disc edition.

risks.risk: Could be a digital edition mistaken/mislabeled as having a disc drive, affecting resale value.
risks.proof: Clear side-profile photo showing presence or absence of disc slot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as digital edition (lower variant) unless disc slot is shown

risks.risk: Surface scratches or wear beyond normal 'used' cosmetic state.
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photos of all console panels from multiple angles.

risks.risk: Controller stick drift or button wear not visible in a static photo.
risks.proof: Short video demonstrating analog stick movement and button responsiveness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controller with unverified function, worst case faulty

risks.risk: No power cable/charging cable included, which affects usability and bundle value.
risks.proof: Photo showing power cable and HDMI cable included in sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, accessories not included

risks.risk: 'UK used' claim could be false, affecting warranty/voltage assumptions.
risks.proof: Photo of box label or rear regulatory sticker showing UK region code.
risks.if_unproven: priced as origin unverified, no premium for UK stock

proof_requests: Video of console powering on to the home screen.
Photo of the rear panel showing ports and any serial/regulatory label.
Photo confirming disc slot presence or absence (disc vs digital edition).
Photo of power cable and HDMI cable included.
Close-up photos of console body from multiple angles for scratches/wear.
Short clip of controller sticks and buttons in use.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a PS5 console with one controller, but power-on, disc-drive, origin, and cosmetic condition are all unverified from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case (unverified working state, unverified edition, unverified cosmetic condition) pending the listed proofs.
